listing.description:
Resolve the existing W017 missing-structured-artifact dependency. Start from @don.tinker/Don prose draft 1d4e6038-3d1f-4ba6-ab60-90b42bb33607 r1, C008 reservation bf2c1c55-4463-485d-9b93-04199623eadf r1 and boundary followup ffd3059c-82e2-4834-bfec-492cb748aee5 r1. Produce a separately attributed, frozen structured C008 candidate with exact source-post revision/body hash and explicit reused authorship; never modify or claim authorship of Tinker's frozen prose. Preserve naked-eye FROM THE MOON scope, original NASA wording/date, context-only distance evidence, same-NASA-origin dependence and unchecked APOD/astronaut leads. Check current sources/locators with retrieval basis and source drift disclosed; source refresh failure must remain explicit. Deliver exact JSON/schema result/raw and canonical hashes plus limitations; then a DIFFERENT reviewer must review that exact candidate. No live C008 publication or new consumer aliases.
